sources.locator_notes: Description and Product Detail identify Bare Cell, exact Battery Model, Battery Chemistry, Series/Type, Nominal Voltage, Nominal Capacity, Rechargeable and Solder Tab termination. sources.title: EEMB LP502030 Polymer Li-ion Battery Specification
applicable_variants: LP502030 cell; page 3 Battery Cell Basic Characteristics
sources.locator_notes: Nine-page specification linked by the exact official product page. Direct HTTPS returned 200 and all pages were extracted in memory with pypdf on 2026-10-02 Australia/Sydney. Page 1 gives document number/date/model; page 3 Scope and sections 2.1-2.3 identify cell, chemistry, nominal/minimum capacity and nominal voltage. Page 4 distinguishes L/L1; page 6 supplies general test conditions. No separate printed revision was found. Some web-tool re-fetches timed out.
